text_en: Now Jehoshaphat had great riches and honor; and he made a marriage alliance with Ahab.
text_cn: 约沙法特的财产丰富，尊荣很大，且与阿哈布联婚。

text_en: After some years he went down to Ahab in Samaria. Ahab slaughtered an abundance of sheep and oxen for him and for the people who were with him, and induced him to go up against Ramoth-gilead.
text_cn: 几年以后，他到撒玛黎雅去见阿哈布。阿哈布为他和跟从他的随员，宰杀了许多牛羊，怂恿他去攻打辣摩特基肋阿得。

text_en: King Ahab of Israel said to King Jehoshaphat of Judah, “Will you go with me to Ramoth-gilead? ” He answered him, “I am with you, my people are your people. We will be with you in the war. ”
text_cn: 以色列王阿哈布对犹大王约沙法特说：“你愿意同我一起去攻打辣摩特基肋阿得吗？”约沙法特回答说：“你我原不分彼此，我的人民就是你的人民；我必与你同去作战。”

text_en: But Jehoshaphat also said to the king of Israel, “Inquire first for the word of the Lord . ”
text_cn: 约沙法特对以色列王说：“请你先求问上主的答话！”

text_en: Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together, four hundred of them, and said to them, “Shall we go to battle against Ramoth-gilead, or shall I refrain? ” They said, “Go up; for God will give it into the hand of the king. ”
text_cn: 以色列王于是召集了先知，共四百人，问他们说：“我们应该上去进攻辣摩特基肋阿得？还是不去呢？”他们回答说：“上去，天主必将那地交于大王手中。”

text_en: But Jehoshaphat said, “Is there no other prophet of the Lord here of whom we may inquire? ”
text_cn: 但是约沙法特说：“这里就没有一位上主的先知，我们可以托他求问吗？”

text_en: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “There is still one other by whom we may inquire of the Lord , Micaiah son of Imlah; but I hate him, for he never prophesies anything favorable about me, but only disaster. ” Jehoshaphat said, “Let the king not say such a thing. ”
text_cn: 以色列王回答约沙法特说：“还有一个人，可以托他求问上主，不过我憎恨他，因为他对我说预言，总不说吉祥话，常说凶言；这人就是依默拉的儿子米加雅。”约沙法特对他说：“请大王别这样说！”

text_en: Then the king of Israel summoned an officer and said, “Bring quickly Micaiah son of Imlah. ”
text_cn: 于是以色列王召来一个宦官，吩咐他说：“快去将依默拉的儿子米加雅召来！”

text_en: Now the king of Israel and King Jehoshaphat of Judah were sitting on their thrones, arrayed in their robes; and they were sitting at the threshing floor at the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets were prophesying before them.
text_cn: 当时以色列王和犹大王约沙法特在撒玛黎雅城门前的广场上，各穿朝服，坐在宝座上；所有的先知在他们面前说预言。

text_en: Zedekiah son of Chenaanah made for himself horns of iron, and he said, “Thus says the Lord : With these you shall gore the Arameans until they are destroyed. ”
text_cn: 革纳阿纳的儿子漆德克雅带了一些铁角说：“上主这样说：你要用这些铁角刺杀阿兰人，直到将他们消灭。”

text_en: All the prophets were prophesying the same and saying, “Go up to Ramoth-gilead and triumph; the Lord will give it into the hand of the king. ”
text_cn: 所有的先知也这样预言说：“你上辣摩特基肋阿得去必会胜利，上主必将那地交于大王手中！”

text_en: The messenger who had gone to summon Micaiah said to him, “Look, the words of the prophets with one accord are favorable to the king; let your word be like the word of one of them, and speak favorably. ”
text_cn: 那去召米加雅的使者对米加雅说：“看，先知们都异口同声对君王说吉祥的话，希望你说的话也与他们每人说的话一样，也是吉祥的话！”

text_en: But Micaiah said, “As the Lord lives, whatever my God says, that I will speak. ”
text_cn: 米加雅回答说：“我指着永生的上主起誓：我的天主吩咐什么，我就说什么！”

text_en: When he had come to the king, the king said to him, “Micaiah, shall we go to Ramoth-gilead to battle, or shall I refrain? ” He answered, “Go up and triumph; they will be given into your hand. ”
text_cn: 米加雅来到王那里，王就问他说：“米加雅，我们应该上去进攻辣摩特基肋阿得，还是不去呢？”他回答说：“上去，必然胜利，他们必落在你们手中。”

text_en: But the king said to him, “How many times must I make you swear to tell me nothing but the truth in the name of the Lord ? ”
text_cn: 君王对他说：“我应当多少次叫你宣誓，你才奉上主的名，对我说实话呢？”

text_en: Then Micaiah said, “I saw all Israel scattered on the mountains, like sheep without a shepherd; and the Lord said, ‘These have no master; let each one go home in peace. ’”
text_cn: 米加雅答说：“我看见全以色列散在山上，好像没有牧人的羊群。上主说：这些人既然没有主人，更好各自平安回家去吧！”

text_en: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “Did I not tell you that he would not prophesy anything favorable about me, but only disaster? ”
text_cn: 以色列王对约沙法特说：“我不是告诉过你，他对我说预言，总不说吉祥话，只说凶言么？”

text_en: Then Micaiah said, “Therefore hear the word of the Lord : I saw the Lord sitting on his throne, with all the host of heaven standing to the right and to the left of him.
text_cn: 米加雅答说：“请你们静听上主的话：我见上主坐在宝座上，天上的万军侍立在他左右。

text_en: And the Lord said, ‘Who will entice King Ahab of Israel, so that he may go up and fall at Ramoth-gilead? ’ Then one said one thing, and another said another,
text_cn: 上主问说：谁去唆使以色列王阿哈布上去，叫他阵亡在辣摩特基肋阿得呢？那时有的说这样，有的说那样。

text_en: until a spirit came forward and stood before the Lord , saying, ‘I will entice him. ’ The Lord asked him, ‘How? ’
text_cn: 以后有一个神出来，立在上主面前说：我能唆使他。上主问他说：用什么方法？

text_en: He replied, ‘I will go out and be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets. ’ Then the Lord said, ‘You are to entice him, and you shall succeed; go out and do it. ’
text_cn: 那神答说：我去，在他所有先知们口中做虚言的神。上主回答说：你能唆使，也必会成功，就去照样办吧！

text_en: So you see, the Lord has put a lying spirit in the mouth of these your prophets; the Lord has decreed disaster for you. ”
text_cn: 现在上主将虚言的神放入你这些先知口中，上主已注定你必遭殃。”

text_en: Then Zedekiah son of Chenaanah came up to Micaiah, slapped him on the cheek, and said, “Which way did the spirit of the Lord pass from me to speak to you? ”
text_cn: 那时，革纳阿纳的儿子漆德克雅前来，打米加雅的脸说：“上主的神由哪条路离开了我，而同你说话呢？”

text_en: Micaiah replied, “You will find out on that day when you go in to hide in an inner chamber. ”
text_cn: 米加雅答说：“在你进入最严密的室内隐藏的那一天，你就会知道了！”

text_en: The king of Israel then ordered, “Take Micaiah, and return him to Amon the governor of the city and to Joash the king’s son;
text_cn: 以色列王吩咐说：“将米加雅带去，交给阿孟市长和约阿布王子，

text_en: and say, ‘Thus says the king: Put this fellow in prison, and feed him on reduced rations of bread and water until I return in peace. ’”
text_cn: 说君王这样吩咐：将这人下在监里，少给他吃的喝的，等我平安回来。”

text_en: Micaiah said, “If you return in peace, the Lord has not spoken by me. ” And he said, “Hear, you peoples, all of you! ”
text_cn: 米加雅说：“你如果能平安回来，那么，上主就没藉我说过话。”又说：“众百姓！你们要听清楚啊！”

text_en: So the king of Israel and King Jehoshaphat of Judah went up to Ramoth-gilead.
text_cn: 以色列王遂与犹大王约沙法特上去进攻辣摩特基肋阿得。

text_en: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “I will disguise myself and go into battle, but you wear your robes. ” So the king of Israel disguised himself, and they went into battle.
text_cn: 以色列王对约沙法特说：“我要改装上阵，你可仍穿朝服。”于是以色列王改装上了阵。

text_en: Now the king of Aram had commanded the captains of his chariots, “Fight with no one small or great, but only with the king of Israel. ”
text_cn: 阿兰王曾吩咐自己的战车队长说：“你们不必与大小将士交战，只攻打以色列王。”

text_en: When the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, they said, “It is the king of Israel. ” So they turned to fight against him; and Jehoshaphat cried out, and the Lord helped him. God drew them away from him,
text_cn: 战车队长一看见约沙法特，便说：“这必是以色列王！”遂将他包围，向他进攻；约沙法特连声叫苦，上主援助了他，天主使敌人远离了他。

text_en: for when the captains of the chariots saw that it was not the king of Israel, they turned back from pursuing him.
text_cn: 战车队长见他不是以色列王，就不再追击他。

text_en: But a certain man drew his bow and unknowingly struck the king of Israel between the scale armor and the breastplate; so he said to the driver of his chariot, “Turn around, and carry me out of the battle, for I am wounded. ”
text_cn: 有人偶然一箭，正射入以色列王的铠甲与腰带中，君王对驾车的人说：“转回，载我离开阵地，我已受伤。”

text_en: The battle grew hot that day, and the king of Israel propped himself up in his chariot facing the Arameans until evening; then at sunset he died.
text_cn: 但那天战事越来越激烈，以色列王仍立在车上，抵抗阿兰人，直到晚上；日落的时候，王就死了。
